text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1455 Kickdown Rubber Tip

This is a replacement rubber tip for the Don-Jo 1455 Kickdown Door Stop.

Note: The Kickdown door holder does NOT have to be removed from the door to replace the rubber tip. It is threaded and screws directly onto the door stop.

Specifications for the Don-Jo 1468 Rubber Tip Replacement:

  • Diameter: 15/16"
  • Threaded Diameter: 5/8"
  • Total Length: 11/16"
  • Gray Rubber

Warning: These work for 4" Kickdown Door Holders manufactured by Don-Jo. If you are not sure if your Kickdown's were manufactured by Don-Jo, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
